claims.counts: Repeated slots/passes and separately executed exact names count checks, not unique numerical encodings or exhaustive domains. The same three supplied input families are used across all contexts.
claims.optimization: All fifteen are identical-ELF controls. Absolute whole-fixture callback times are retained; no saving, isolated operator cost, hard deadline or current instrument utilization is inferred.
claims.outputs: Each exact source context passed complete repeated same-image numerical/PCM/raw-bit pair comparisons and independent model/cache checks. Full target waveforms were not downloaded.
claims.recovery: Root-operated application-only tests restored the identified instrument to compiled defaults, unpaused50. This publisher performs no device operation.
claims.surface: Each exact GenExpr call/infix source was independently authored, exported, compiled and executed. Equal canonical/alias ELF bytes confer no qualification on unexecuted names, RNBO patcher/codebox, visual Gen, other overloads/resources/events or arbitrary user programs.
claims.truth: Independent binary64 operations over exact binary32 operands followed by once-binary32 output rounding. A product needs at most48 significand bits and remains within the binary64 exponent range. Min/max canonical caches select the first operand on ties; operation zero-sign differences were permitted diagnostics, all observed differences were zero.
